ei.title: Culture Notes - Protecting Elves, Protecting Nature
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these (A)[imaginary / real] beings gives them an (B)[emotional / rational] connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and (C)[protect / neglect] rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 상상 속 존재, 감정적 연결, 보호하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ imaginary — emotional — protect: 원문 그대로 ←정답
❌ ② neglect는 protect의 반의어
❌ ③ real은 imaginary의 반의어
❌ ① rational은 emotional의 반의어
det.tip: imaginary(상상의), emotional(감정적인), protect(보호하다)는 아이슬란드의 엘프 문화를 설명하는 핵심 어휘입니다.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being (C)[protected / endangered]!
